item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00271","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C02","C16","C09"],"selected_candidate_label":"C02","confidence":0.86,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C02 plausibly supplied the core drafting framework: legally described tracts are added to and reserved as parts of named national forests, followed by a provision governing their administration under applicable rules and regulations. The child adapts that concrete national-forest enlargement machinery to former military lands and adds distinctive joint Agriculture-Army administration and an Army-use reservation. C16 is a close structural analogue involving surveyed parcels included in a national forest, but its supplied text lacks the child's administrative machinery. C09 uses similar land-addition and management language for a national monument rather than a national forest.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The lands hereby reserved as an addition to the Fort Missoula District of the Lolo National Forest","parent_excerpt":"are hereby added to and reserved as parts of the respective national forests","explanation":"Both use the same operative device of adding specifically described lands to an existing national forest reservation."},{"child_excerpt":"shall be administered by the Secretary of Agriculture under such rules and regulations","parent_excerpt":"shall be administered under the laws, rules, and regulations applicable to national-forest lands","explanation":"Both follow the reservation with materially parallel language assigning an administrative regime for the newly added forest lands."},{"child_excerpt":"MONTANA PRINCIPAL MERIDIAN ...
